map.为什么高海拔气压明显降低？: Why does atmospheric pressure drop clearly at high altitude?
map.受天气系统、温度、湿度影响明显。同一海拔上高低压天气可使读数偏差数百米，需结合温: It is clearly affected by the weather system, temperature and humidity. At the same altitude, high and low pressure weather can shift the reading by hundreds of metres, so a temperature correction or a measured sea-level pressure is needed.
map.在无人机、探空气球等高度估算中，用气压变化判断升降。: In altitude estimation for drones and weather balloons, judge ascent and descent from the pressure change.
map.大气压与海拔转换（气压计读数） 使用指南: Atmospheric Pressure and Altitude Conversion (Barometer Reading) User Guide
map.大气重量随高度递减，约每升高 5500 m 气压减半；随海拔高度增加，空气柱变短: Atmospheric weight decreases with altitude and the pressure roughly halves for every 5500 m of climb; as altitude rises the air column shortens and density falls, so the reading drops.
map.把已知海拔换算成标准大气压，作为气象或仪器标定的参考基线。: Convert a known altitude into standard atmospheric pressure as a reference baseline for weather or instrument calibration.
map.根据气压计读数换算对应海拔高度，或反过来由海拔估算标准大气压，用于野外测绘、登山: Convert a barometer reading into the corresponding altitude, or estimate standard atmospheric pressure from the altitude, for height estimation in field surveying, mountaineering and weather observation.
map.登山或野外测绘时，由气压计读数反推当前海拔高度。: Back-calculate the current altitude from a barometer reading when mountaineering or doing field surveying.
map.示例：气压 540 hPa 对应海拔: Example: an altitude corresponding to 540 hPa
map.：采用等温近似 h=44330·(1−(P/P₀)^(1/5.255))，P₀=: : uses the isothermal approximation h = 44330*(1-(P/P₀)^(1/5.255)) with P₀=1013.25 hPa. P/P₀ ≈ 0.533, its 1/5.255 power ≈ 0.879, so h ≈ 44330*(1-0.879) ≈ 5360 m.
